summary: Expanded the metric guidance requirement and acceptance criteria to cover status-derived phase names that are not accepted metric phases.

items.title: Status-derived phases are not all valid metric phases
items.rationale: Updated R1 and related acceptance/test text so implementation must avoid presenting non-VALID_PHASES status-derived names such as `plan` and `finalize` as metric phases.
items.evidence: spec.json requirements[0].desc and acceptance_criteria now require guidance to use only `VALID_PHASES` metric phase examples and to avoid `plan`/`finalize` examples.
